question.text: Let the position vectors of points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>Q</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>R</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math> be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>17</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>16</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math>, respectively. Then which of the following statements is true?

options.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math> is the position vector of a point which divides <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mi>R</mi></math> internally in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>4</mn></math>

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math> is the position vector of a point which divides <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mi>R</mi></math> externally in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>4</mn></math>

The square of magnitude of the vector <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>95</mn></math>

solution.text:
Given,

P(1,2,-5), Q(3,6,3), R175,165,7 & S(2,1,1)

Now solving options,

Option A checking points are coplanar,

PQ→=2,4,8, PR→=125,65,12 & PQ→=1,-1,6

Now if points are coplanar then, PQ→PR→PS→=0

Now solving L.H.S, we get,

24812565121-16=25124126601-16=2596-24-72=0

Hence, they are coplanar

So option A is wrong. 

Now solving, option B we get,

b→+2d→3=7i+8j+5k3

So, on taking coefficient of i^ we get,

⇒  17λ5+1(λ+1)=73

⇒  17λ5+1=73(λ+1)

⇒51λ+15=35λ+35

⇒16λ=20

⇒λ=54, hence option B is correct and option C is wrong,

Now solving option D we get,

b→×d→=i^j^k^363211=3i^+3j^-9k^

⇒b→×d→2=32+32+922=99,

Hence, option D is wrong.
